widget_prompt: Plot what I paid each calendar day during the current month.

scenes.narration: AgentMeter lets tool makers sell useful APIs, with budgets and receipts for AI agents.

A provider registers a read-only invoice API, sets a one-cent price, tests a synthetic input, and publishes it through MCP. This is a free sample service; the invoice amount is separate from the tool fee.
scenes.action: Local sample registration, probe and publication. This is separate from the hosted provider used next.

scenes.narration: Now a live Codex model calls the registered invoice tool through MCP. Synthetic invoices and a filtered client keep keys and account details off screen. Three successful calls consume three cents of existing PayPal sandbox credit: four ninety-four becomes four ninety-one. The provider earns three cents. Each row shows the real result and backend receipt. We captured two model turns, cutting idle waits. A local gateway enforces the three-cent allowance.
scenes.screen: Privacy-filtered Codex live client → hosted registered API
scenes.action: Actual gpt-6.1-sol turns, three stored hosted receipts, buyer $4.94 → $4.91 and provider $0 → $0.03. Two model turns; idle waits and resume setup removed by hard cuts.

scenes.narration: In the separate offline demo, a failing request releases its hold and costs zero. Retries avoid duplicate charges.
scenes.action: Show the earlier local zero-charge failure. These are different accounts from the hosted Codex run.

scenes.narration: The offline provider can pay out three cents of simulated earnings. Success clears the balance and keeps the receipt. This is separate from the hosted Codex run.
scenes.action: Earlier mock payout success; the new hosted earnings remain unpaid.

scenes.narration: Reconciliation separates purchased credit, payment fees, and cash received. These two matches use simulated payment receipts.
scenes.action: Hold the two earlier simulated reporting matches.

scenes.narration: Now I ask, plot what I paid each calendar day this month. Real Gemini converts the question into a validated intent. Our custom Studio analyst delegates to the Page agent, which creates a chart and returns the task. The source names Gemini. The custom receipt widget and themed Grid expose usage and cost. Historical rows are synthetic; analysis never moves funds.
scenes.action: Preserve the real Gemini/Studio handoff footage at normal speed, then the themed Grid.

scenes.narration: The permanent Render backend also has a completed PayPal sandbox payout. Fresh PayPal reads verify that receipt. Transaction Search may arrive later, so pending reporting stays visible. A restart preserved the recorded balances and receipts.
scenes.screen: Earlier completed hosted PayPal sandbox evidence
scenes.action: Earlier payout and reporting footage; no new payout was made for the Codex filming take.

scenes.narration: Your service. Your price. A receipt for every call. AgentMeter: meter, settle, verify.
